successCriteria.note: AGENTS section above FOLDERS; + opens the add-agent pane with three cards, each with Find and Download (DM-50, DM-61).

Find runs and identifies the executable before connecting; live with Claude Code 2.1.281 (DM-47, DM-61). Download installs after a native confirmation and shows the version; it is checked with fake downloads only (DM-48), as the criterion now says after the person's cull on 2026-10-05.
Agents block per folder; the new chat asks for agent, model and role, and runs in that folder (DM-56; DM-61, DM-199 and DM-212 live).
Transcript and context survive a restart (DM-61 step 6); the model switches between turns and the agent is fixed.
Edits and commands ask first and Deny is reported back: live for Claude (DM-61; DM-212 including memory-folder writes, closed by DM-213), replay tests for Codex and Cursor (live culled).
The chat's agent calls this folder's Dark Mechanicus tools with its role (live orchestrators in DM-90 and DM-199); the chat registers as a session (footer count, list_sessions).
No credential field or storage. Sign-in runs each CLI's own login (DM-49), and no agent ever ran a login.
Start run offers Run with agent or Leave pending (DM-59); run live in DM-61, DM-90 and DM-199.
Hourglass on working tickets in the graph and list, opening a live Activity tab (DM-93; DM-90).
Orchestrator chip and live feed of claims (model, rationale), heartbeats, reviews, pauses and reports (DM-94; DM-90).
The bound worker thread streams in the Activity tab with Open chat (DM-99; DM-90). It binds without a nudge since DM-203, and reads without starting an agent since DM-211 (DM-199).
An external host's progress notes and run events show in the attempt panel (DM-91, DM-92; DM-90 part A).
Collapsible subagent threads and action markers that open the ticket or epic (DM-100; DM-90, DM-199).
Tokens are masked in stored and streamed text, including glued and cut-short ones (DM-51, DM-91, DM-201); searches in DM-90 and DM-199 found none, with a positive control.
Sign in is prompted after Find or Download, in the new-chat flow and in Start run (DM-124); the flag clears on any signed-in check (DM-206). Live for Claude, tests for Codex and Cursor.
Live in DM-61: Signed out card, Sign in, then Retry; the orchestrator chat's run paused with its leases kept. DM-206 shows Retry only when cut short; DM-202 leaves the resume to the person.

outcome.summary:
The Agents epic is delivered in four sprints on `agents`, each a squashed commit:
- 417a154: connect Claude Code, Codex and Cursor; chat per folder with approvals; sign-in; Start run with an agent.
- 5043f7c: live activity: progress notes, timelines, the hourglass, the orchestrator feed, subagent threads and bindings.
- 4518afd: fixes from the live checks.
- d3441e7: memory-folder writes ask.

Every sprint passed the full Definition of Done. Fireguard graded A 97, A 92, A 95 and A 100.

Verified live on Windows with the person's Claude Code in four acceptance walkthroughs (docs/reports/agents-e2e.md, live-activity-e2e.md and agents-fixes-e2e.md with its Sprint 4 section).

Not run live: Codex, Cursor, macOS and a live Download. The person culled these on 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-05; they are covered by replay, unit and fake-download tests.

All 16 success criteria are met as worded in revision 11.
